name: Sourwood
desc: Sourwood (Oxydendrum arboreum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Oxydendrum arboreum ( OK-sih-DEN-drəm ar-BOR-ee-əm), commonly known as sourwood or sorrel tree, is the sole species in the genus Oxydendrum, in the family Ericaceae.
